targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action='BUY') AS buys, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action='SELL') AS sells FROM signals WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals WHERE ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT ts, action, spot, score, regime, kelly_fraction, lot_size, risk_usd, r_multiple FROM signals ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT ts AS time, SUM(r_multiple) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS cum_r FROM signals WHERE r_multiple IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts
